description: Update an existing script. Each of name, type, commands, variables, and tags is optional: a field left out keeps its stored value, an empty list clears that list, and a non-empty list replaces the whole list, never merging into it. A script's type cannot be changed: type, if sent, must match the script's bot type, so to switch types create a new script of the desired type instead. Sending commands or variables saves a new revision; a name or tags alone save no revision. Read the script with get_script before changing it, never rebuild it from list_scripts. Every write against a user's existing data needs their explicit confirmation first.

script.description: The fields to change: name, type, commands, and variables. Leave a field out to keep it, or omit script to change only the tags. type, if sent, must be the script's current type; a different type is rejected.

tags.description: Tag names; a name the team doesn't have yet becomes a new tag. Omit to keep the current tags; send [] to clear them.

name: update_script
title: Update Script
